confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Bilbao prices. The price search returned Numbeo-derived data via Expatica (June 2026), plus MyLifeElsewhere and GoTripzi. It found beer, cappuccino and restaurant meal prices, and these sources differ by a few euros. It found no cocktail prices and no restaurant wine prices. Cocktail and wine are estimates based on the local beer price, with cocktail at about 2.8x beer and a glass of wine at about the beer price (a bit above). The EUR to USD conversion used a rough rate of about 1.16, which I assumed and did not check. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not based on any booking pages or listings. July is peak season, so accommodation is the least certain part.
comparable_city_reasoning: Bilbao is one of the pricier Spanish cities. It is priced similar to San Sebastian but below it, and above Madrid or Valencia for eating out. Restaurant anchors come from the Numbeo-derived figures: about €18.7 for an inexpensive meal, about €65 for a three-course meal for two, about €3.4 for a draught beer, and about €2.1 for a cappuccino.
